title: My Chromebook won't charge
summary: Your Chromebook turns on, but the battery won't charge when you plug it in.

steps.title: Safety check first
instructions: Look at your Chromebook and charger. Do NOT touch them if they feel very hot.
Check if the bottom of the Chromebook is bulging or the case is being pushed apart.
Check for smoke or a burning smell.
steps.question: Do you notice any of these: bulging, very hot, smoke, or a burning smell?

steps.title: Check for damage
instructions: Look at the whole charger cable and both plugs.
Look at the charging port on the Chromebook.
Check for cuts, frayed wires, bent plugs, or a loose or broken port.
steps.question: Do you see any damage?

steps.title: Use your own charger
instructions: Use the charger that came with your Chromebook.
steps.question: Do you have your Chromebook's charger?

steps.title: Plug it back in firmly
instructions: Unplug the charger from the Chromebook and from the wall.
Plug it firmly into the wall outlet, then firmly into the Chromebook.
Look at the battery icon in the bottom-right corner of the screen. A lightning bolt means it is charging.
steps.question: Does the battery icon show it is charging?

steps.title: Try a different outlet
instructions: Plug the charger into a different wall outlet.
Wait one minute and look at the battery icon again.
steps.question: Is it charging now?

steps.title: Try the other charging port
instructions: Some Chromebooks have a charging port on both sides.
If yours does, plug the charger into the other port.
If yours has only one charging port, answer No.
steps.question: Is it charging now?

steps.title: Turn it off and on again
instructions: Press and hold the power button until the screen goes dark.
Wait 10 seconds, then press the power button once to turn it back on.
steps.question: Is it charging now?
